createQuiz.title: Create a quiz
createQuiz.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Assignment & Assessment module.
createQuiz.step2: Pick the Quiz Bank section from the submenu.
createQuiz.step3: Click the Create Quiz button to start building a new quiz.

createRequest.title: Create a request
createRequest.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Communication & Reporting module.
createRequest.step2: Pick the Requests section from the submenu.
createRequest.step3: Click the New Request button to open the request form.

checkSchedule.title: Check my schedule
checkSchedule.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Dashboard & Scheduling module.
checkSchedule.step2: Pick the Schedule Management section from the submenu.
checkSchedule.step3: Explore the calendar: switch between Day, Week, and Month views and click a block to see lesson details.

takeQuiz.title: Take a quiz
takeQuiz.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Assignment & Assessment module.
takeQuiz.step2: Pick the Quiz Bank section from the submenu.
takeQuiz.step3: Select a quiz from the list, then click Take Quiz to start answering questions.

submitForm.title: Create a dynamic form
submitForm.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Dynamic Forms page.
submitForm.step2: Click the New Form button to start building a new form template.

viewGrades.title: View my grades
viewGrades.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
viewGrades.step2: On the My Grades tab, review the average grade, present rate, absences, and per-subject progress.

startChat.title: Start a chat
startChat.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Communication & Reporting module.
startChat.step2: Pick the Chat section from the submenu.
startChat.step3: Choose a conversation and start typing in the composer at the bottom.

shareFile.title: Share a file
shareFile.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Communication & Reporting module.
shareFile.step2: Pick the File Sharing section from the submenu.
shareFile.step3: Click the Upload File button and choose the file you want to share.
